playpause.note: Reads as a clay pellet with pressed-in symbols; nicely irregular shape.

prev.note: Fits the material style, good debossed icon.

queue.note: Symbols are neatly pressed into the clay.

vol.note: Looks like a sculpted knob; turns well in the second frame.

seek.note: Slider reads as a clay track with a sculpted thumb piece; slides correctly.

shuffle.note: Switch is a chunky piece of clay; flips down convincingly.

visualizer.note: Screen is recessed neatly into the clay frame; dotted accent line looks painted or inlaid.

album_art.note: Screen area looks like a smoothed slab set into the wobbly clay body.

notes: The overall texture and marbling effect on the body perfectly captures the claymation brief.
Buttons and knobs look hand-sculpted and tactile.
Icons are debossed cleanly as if stamped into the clay.
The interaction states (slider moved, switch flipped, knob turned) are well executed.
improve: Adding more pronounced thumbprints or tool marks to the main body could enhance the stop-motion feel even further.
The screens are very flat and perfect; making them slightly wavy or uneven could fit the handmade theme better.
